The initial ल् and श् and the gutturals of all affixes, except , तद्धित are indicatory.

Terms: इत्

The affix उकञ् comes after the following verbs, in the sense of 'agent having such habit etc.' - 1. लष् 2. पत् 3. पद् 4. स्था 5. भू 6. वृष् 7. हन् 8. कम् 9. गम् 10. शॄ ।

Terms: उकञ्

In the place of ल will be substituted the affixes we shall announce hereafter.

Terms: ल
